processTitle: Our post-construction termite treatment process in Goa
processIntro: A clear plan for Goa properties, from the first conversation to agreed aftercare.
steps: Check accessible timber, mud tubes and the junctions where activity has been noticed. Share your locality in Goa, the property type and any access arrangements.
Review entry routes, building finishes and the treatment access available. For properties in Panaji, Porvorim and nearby areas, explain which rooms or site zones need attention.
Explain the proposed work, including drilling and injection where suitable, before treatment starts. Your Goa quotation confirms the agreed areas, preparation and appointment arrangements.
Treat the agreed areas and address affected woodwork as set out in your service plan. The visit is coordinated with the household, builder or facilities contact for your Goa property.
Explain preparation for re-use, monitoring and any agreed follow-up or warranty terms. Keep the service information and contact our team if you notice new signs at your Goa property.
